MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})<- [t:TRANSFER]-(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})<- [t:TRANSFER]-(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE start.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (start)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(reach:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE reach <> start
RETURN count(DISTINCT reach) AS reachable_accounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE start.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (start)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(reach:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE reach <> start
RETURN count(DISTINCT reach) AS reachable_accounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(acct:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, count(acct) AS totalAccounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(acct:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, count(acct) AS totalAccounts
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN dst.acct_no AS counterparty LIMIT $limit
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN dst.acct_no AS counterparty LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:INVEST]->(c:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:INVEST]->(c:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, acctCount
ORDER BY acctCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, acctCount
ORDER BY acctCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(b {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(c {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE (a:Person OR a:Company) AND (b:Person OR b:Company) AND (c:Person OR c:Company)
RETURN count(*) AS chainCount, count(DISTINCT a) AS distinctStarters
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(b {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(c {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE (a:Person OR a:Company) AND (b:Person OR b:Company) AND (c:Person OR c:Company)
RETURN count(*) AS chainCount, count(DISTINCT a) AS distinctStarters
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (a)-[r:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN c.code AS channel, count(r) AS transaction_count
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (a)-[r:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN c.code AS channel, count(r) AS transaction_count
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(receiver:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH sender, count(*) AS transfers
WHERE transfers >= $min_count
RETURN sender.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, transfers
ORDER BY transfers DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(receiver:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH sender, count(*) AS transfers
WHERE transfers >= $min_count
RETURN sender.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, transfers
ORDER BY transfers DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [t:TRANSFER] -> (dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) WHERE t.amount < $amount_max RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [t:TRANSFER] -> (dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) WHERE t.amount < $amount_max RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loan_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loan_count

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (l)-[r:REPAY]->() WITH l, sum(r.amount) AS total_repaid WHERE total_repaid < $repaid_ratio * l.principal RETURN l.id AS loan_id, l.principal, total_repaid LIMIT $limit
